title: Perils Schedule for the Bluegate Tenant Protection Plan
content:
The Bluegate Tenant Protection Plan covers loss from a listed set of perils and never covers loss from the excluded perils. The schedule below gives, for each of the six coverage levels, whether each peril is covered or excluded.

## Perils by coverage level

| Peril | $2,000 Plan | $3,000 Plan | $5,000 Plan | $7,500 Plan | $10,000 Plan | $15,000 Plan |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| fire and smoke | Covered | Covered | Covered | Covered | Covered | Covered |
| burglary | Covered | Covered | Covered | Covered | Covered | Covered |
| vandalism | Covered | Covered | Covered | Covered | Covered | Covered |
| sudden water damage | Covered | Covered | Covered | Covered | Covered | Covered |
| windstorm and hail | Covered | Covered | Covered | Covered | Covered | Covered |
| lightning | Covered | Covered | Covered | Covered | Covered | Covered |
| roof collapse | Covered | Covered | Covered | Covered | Covered | Covered |
| vehicle impact | Covered | Covered | Covered | Covered | Covered | Covered |
| climate-control failure | Excluded | Excluded | Excluded | Excluded | Covered | Covered |
| flood or rising water | Excluded | Excluded | Excluded | Excluded | Excluded | Excluded |
| earthquake | Excluded | Excluded | Excluded | Excluded | Excluded | Excluded |
| mold and mildew | Excluded | Excluded | Excluded | Excluded | Excluded | Excluded |
| vermin and insects | Excluded | Excluded | Excluded | Excluded | Excluded | Excluded |
| mysterious disappearance | Excluded | Excluded | Excluded | Excluded | Excluded | Excluded |
| wear and tear | Excluded | Excluded | Excluded | Excluded | Excluded | Excluded |

## Climate-control failure

Damage from a documented failure of the unit's climate-control system is **not covered** on the $2,000, $3,000, $5,000 and $7,500 Plans, where climate-control failure is an excluded peril, and **is covered** on the $10,000 and $15,000 Plans.

## Burglary and forced entry

At every coverage level a burglary claim needs visible evidence of forced entry.

## Summary by level

- **$2,000, $3,000, $5,000 and $7,500 Plans:** eight covered perils (fire and smoke, burglary, vandalism, sudden water damage, windstorm and hail, lightning, roof collapse, vehicle impact); seven excluded perils (flood or rising water, earthquake, mold and mildew, vermin and insects, mysterious disappearance, wear and tear, climate-control failure).
- **$10,000 and $15,000 Plans:** the same eight covered perils plus climate-control failure; six excluded perils (the list above without climate-control failure).

## Illustration (hypothetical)

Mildew damage found in a unit is an excluded peril at every level. Contents spoiled by a logged climate-control failure fall under an excluded peril on a $7,500 Plan and a covered peril on a $10,000 Plan.
